name: shop-pot
task: Whenever the pot boils over, turn the stove down.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Response(pot_boiling, stove_fixed) clause correctly captures 'Whenever the pot boils over, turn the stove down.' The machine has no FINAL_STATES (rule-only task), which is valid since nothing is unconditionally commanded. The machine enforces that stove_fixed must occur after every pot_boiling event and penalizes failure accordingly.

texts: The agent must turn the stove down every time the pot is boiling over.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, pot_boiling&!stove_fixed) -> u1
(u1, stove_fixed) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, pot_boiling&!stove_fixed, u1) -> -1
(u1, stove_fixed, u0) -> 1
